_comment: MERGE this 'hooks' block into the ~/.claude/settings.json that your `claude` reads (keep any existing keys like model/permissions). Replace the placeholders. If claude runs in a container that bind-mounts host ~/.claude to /root/.claude, the paths below are the CONTAINER paths and MONITOR_SERVER must be the docker-gateway IP the container can reach the host on (find it via `docker inspect <container> | grep Gateway`).

_placeholders.__OMC_URL__: http://172.25.0.1:4825   (host gateway:PORT reachable from where claude runs; use http://127.0.0.1:PORT if claude runs on the host directly)
_placeholders.__NODE__: /usr/local/bin/node   (absolute node path INSIDE the claude env; on the host it is usually /usr/bin/node)
_placeholders.__HOOKS_DIR__: /root/.claude/hooks   (where you copied send_event.js, as seen from the claude env)
